name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: A set of checkable buttons where no more than one can be checked at a time.
docs:
## When to use - A small, fixed set of options where exactly one applies: a plan, a priority, a shipping method. - Anywhere seeing all the options at once matters more than saving space. - A setting that applies on submit, not immediately. ## When not to use - Several answers can be true; use `checkbox`. - The setting applies the moment it changes; use `switch`. - More than about seven options, or a list that is filtered as you type; use `select` or `combobox`, which handle long lists and search. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/radio-group ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/cadence/radio-group/radio-group"; import { Label } from "@/components/cadence/label/label"; export function Plan() { return (
); } ``` Every item needs a `value`. The group is one form field: `name` goes on the group, not on the items. ## Examples ### Controlled ```tsx const [plan, setPlan] = useState("team"); … ; ``` `onValueChange` receives the new value plus Base UI's event details. ### Invalid ```tsx …

Choose a plan to continue.

``` `aria-invalid` on the group styles the items and is announced with the group. ### Disabled item ```tsx ``` A disabled item is still visible and still announced, so the option does not appear to vanish. ## API ### `RadioGroup` | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | --------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- | | `value` | `string` | – | Controlled selection. | | `defaultValue` | `string` | – | Uncontrolled initial selection. | | `onValueChange` | `(value, details) => void` | – | Fired when the selection changes. | | `name` | `string` | – | Form field name, submitted with the selection. | | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every item. | | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks submit until something is selected. | | `className` | `string` | – | Merged last; the default is `grid gap-3`. | ### `RadioGroupItem` | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ----------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | | `value` | `string` | – | Required. Identifies this option. | | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the option visible but unselectable.| | `className` | `string` | – | Merged last. | ## Motion contract Recipe: `state.morph`. The dot of the newly selected item fades in and settles from 0.96 to full size; the previously selected dot reverses. Nothing else in the row moves, so the eye follows the choice. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | --------- | --------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------- | | select | `opacity 0 → 1`, `scale 0.96 → 1` | `state.morph` | yes | | deselect | the same pair, reversed | `state.morph` | yes | | reduced | `opacity` only | `state.morph` | yes | | none | no transition | – | – | ## Keyboard interactions | Keys | Action | | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | | `Tab` | Enters the group at the selected item (or the first one). | | `Arrow Right/Down` | Selects the next item and moves focus. | | `Arrow Left/Up` | Selects the previous item and moves focus. | | `Space` | Selects the focused item. | There is one tab stop for the whole group, not one per item: that is the roving tabindex Base UI implements. ## Accessibility - The group renders `role="radiogroup"`; each item renders `role="radio"` with a hidden input, so the form still submits a value. - `aria-checked` carries the state on its own. The dot animation is never the only signal. - Name the group with `aria-labelledby` pointing at a visible heading, or with `aria-label` when a heading would be redundant. - `aria-invalid` belongs on the group: it describes the whole choice. ## Validation and data ownership | The component does | You do | | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | | Styles and announces `aria-invalid` on the group | Deciding that a choice is required | | Forwards `name`, `required`, and the selection | Server-side validation of the submitted value | | Keeps arrow-key navigation within the group | Focus policy after a failed submit | There is no `validate` or `schema` prop. See [validation](/docs/validation). ## Responsive behavior Items stack by default (`grid gap-3`). For a horizontal row of short labels, set `className="flex flex-wrap gap-6"`; do not shorten the labels to fit — wrap them. ## Performance One Motion element per item, each animating only `opacity` and `transform`, and only when the selection changes. No layout thrash: the dot is absolutely sized by CSS, so no measurement happens. ## Notes for AI - Use `radio-group` for "one of N" and `checkbox` for "any of N". - Put `name` and `aria-invalid` on the group, not on the items. - Do not build a radio group out of buttons with `aria-pressed`; the radio role is what gives arrow-key navigation and form submission.
